name: pro_session
title: OS-E2E-13: a pro session on t-v16, the HIL twin of sim/scenarios/e2e/e2e_pro_session.txt: mute and solo, a Perform slot held and RESET, a tempo change, Fill and PAT-OPS (undone), the song exported as a WAV, SAVE AS Track NN, the project opened again and its song measured on the USB AUDIO capture (profile 10: stem n = track n, master L = channel 9); the scratch project is hidden at the end

steps.say: OS-E2E-13, the HIL twin of sim/scenarios/e2e/e2e_pro_session.txt: a power user's session on t-v16: mute and solo measured on the USB AUDIO capture (profile 10: stem n = track n, master L = channel 9), a Perform slot held and RESET, a tempo change on Song, a Fill and a PAT-OPS edit (undone), the song exported as a WAV, SAVE AS, reload, and the song measured again. The sim journey builds its own song; the unit one uses the maintainer's t-v16.

steps.note: the master is channel 9 only in USB profile 10 (the tester, int.9); profile 8 has no master channel
(Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is Back)
(the cpu counters are since boot or since this reset: a scenario that checks underruns / over-budget starts from zero)

steps.say: 1. the song plays: the stems sound (T2 is the bass, above -30 dBFS RMS)

steps.note: Shift + F1: the cursor to the first slot
the baseline: T2 sounds

steps.say: 2. MUTE T2 (TRACKS pads, row 2), then UNMUTE; SOLO T2 (row 4): its stem sounds and the others fall silent (soft: whether T3 has notes in this loop is the project's)

steps.note: muted: T2 is below -90 dBFS
unmuted: T2 is back
SOLO T2 (36 + track)
soloed: T2 sounds
(soft) soloed: another track is silent
UNSOLO
unsoloed: T2 sounds

steps.say: 3. PERFORM: LOWPASS (slot 4, pad 15 = its first row) held with the encoder turned: the master loses level while it is held (soft, the stems' content is the project's); F8 RESET puts it back

steps.note: T1..T4 are the tracks the bank acts on
RESET: every FX off
the master before the hold
the master's meter before the hold (the snapshot the held take is held against)
the held LOWPASS closes
(soft) held: the master's rms is at least 2 dB under the snapshot (the lowpass takes the top end of T4 away; the stems' content is the project's)
(soft) held: the master is still there on the capture
RESET
after RESET the master is back above -45 dBFS RMS

steps.say: 4. a TEMPO change on Song: F7 TEMPO and the encoder; the state's tempo follows (and is put back with UNDO at the end)

steps.note: UNDO the tempo

steps.say: 5. FILL and PAT-OPS on Pattern, undone: Fill EVERY 2 on the cursor's track (F4, Down x3, Right, F1), DUPLICATE x2 (F7 TOOLS, Down, F1); F8 undoes each

steps.note: (a pattern already over 64 steps says TOO LONG: 128 STEPS AT MOST, and nothing is written)
UNDO the duplicate (only when one was made)
UNDO the fill
Edit off

steps.say: 6. EXPORT the song as a WAV (File, F6 twice, F7, F1): the progress overlay runs and the strip names the file

steps.note: QA-FIL-021: the song written as Export/<project>/<project>_SONG0001.WAV

steps.say: 7. SAVE AS (File F5 proposes the first free Track NN, F8 takes it), then the project is opened again from File (persistence.json's steps 3 and 5): the save and the reload are the unit's own

steps.note: (the File screen keeps its page when it is left, EXPORT after qa_wavexp: F6 twice ends on PROJECTS from EXPORT or PROJECTS; steps 5 and 7 below find the page as it is left here)
F1 accepts the proposed name (F8 would cancel)

the project's own save job is through (the SAVE_INSTRnn_DONE messages are the samples', one each, and come first; an Open before the end aborts the save); its NN is kept as {{SAVED}} for the DELETE guard of step 7

steps.say: 8. open the saved project from File (the newest of the RECENT group) and play its song again: the stems are back (the samples were read from the card's WAVs: the project was saved with its own)

steps.note: RESCAN
the cursor to the first entry
the first row is the Track NN saved in step 3 ({{SAVED}}), not any Track NN (if not, the RECENT group is not first or another project is newer: nothing is opened)
(only when the strip asks: the state put back counts as a change, and this open is meant to discard it)
the project just saved ({{SAVED}}) is opening
(the load line says `N values reset` when a chunk had values out of range)
QA-FIL-095 (OS-OPENTOPAT): a project that opened shows the Pattern view by itself
(already there since OS-OPENTOPAT; the Pattern button on its own screen changes nothing)
after the reload: T2 sounds as before the save (the same above -30 dBFS RMS bar as the first take)
and the master is there

steps.say: 9. hide the scratch project: persistence.json's step 7, verbatim (the OS has no erase: DELETE writes an empty .deleted in the folder; t-v16 is loaded first because DELETE refuses the open project)

steps.note: RESCAN
the cursor to the first entry
(t-v16 may be the newest row: one Down to the project just saved, at most two)
(soft: the cursor is on the Track NN saved in step 3; if not, nothing below presses Delete)
the question
the second press marks it deleted (sent only while the strip shows the question for the project just saved)
(soft: the project is hidden; if not, the Track NN folder stays listed)

finally.note: (a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is Back)
